		private void cmdFind_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@varno", "value"));
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32((object)CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("varno")).Substring(1));
			if (num.HasValue && num.Value >= 0)
			{
				if (text == "BLOCK-VAR")
				{
					MmgExtensions.GxSearchVariable((MMViewModel)(object)this, ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), num.Value + 1, "", "", "BLOCK-VAR");
				}
				else if (text == "BLOCK-VEC")
				{
					MmgExtensions.GxSearchVariable((MMViewModel)(object)this, ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), num.Value + 1, "", "", "BLOCK-VEC");
				}
			}
			Display();
			((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
		}

		private void cmdClose_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "mbvnum_var2" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				Display();
			}
			if (!pd.Name.EndsWith("_Visible") && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				Display();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				Display();
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void Display()
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.FVN_VARTYPE.@varno", "value"));
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			string text2 = "";
			int num3 = 0;
			if (text == "BLOCK-VEC")
			{
				num2 = 1;
			}
			for (num3 = 0; num3 <= 5; num3++)
			{
				text2 = initialVary[num2, num3];
				int? num4 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + text2 + ".@varno", "can_enter"));
				if (num4.HasValue && num4.Value == 1)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"lblRowSvw_{num}_Visible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"Label_{num}_Caption", (object)initialText[num3]);
					object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + text2 + ".@varno", "option_list");
					if ((obj == null || obj.GetType() == typeof(DBNull)) && !text2.Contains("ID1"))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"cboRowsvw_{num}_Visible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"txtRowsvw_{num}_Visible", (object)"1");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"cboRowsvw_{num}_Visible", (object)"1");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"txtRowsvw_{num}_Visible", (object)"0");
					}
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"vwrow{num}", (object)text2);
					num++;
				}
			}
			for (num3 = num; num3 <= 5; num3++)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"lblRowSvw_{num3}_Visible", (object)"0");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"cboRowsvw_{num3}_Visible", (object)"0");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter($"txtRowsvw_{num3}_Visible", (object)"0");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				int value = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.VARID", "child_count")).Value;
				int value2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.VAR_VAL", "child_count")).Value;
				int value3 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.VAL_STRING", "child_count")).Value;
				if (value >= value2 && value >= value3)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"0");
				}
				else if (value2 >= value && value2 >= value3)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"0");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"1");
				}
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private int Judgement(int? Nint, int? Nreal, int? Nchar)
		{
			if (Nint >= Nreal && Nint >= Nchar && Nreal >= Nchar)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (Nint >= Nreal && Nint >= Nchar && Nchar >= Nreal)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (Nreal >= Nint && Nreal >= Nchar && Nint >= Nchar)
			{
				return 3;
			}
			if (Nreal >= Nint && Nreal >= Nchar && Nchar >= Nint)
			{
				return 4;

			if (Nchar >= Nint && Nchar >= Nreal && Nint >= Nreal)
			{
				return 5;
			}
			if (Nchar >= Nint && Nchar >= Nreal && Nreal >= Nint)
			{
				return 6;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void ChangeGridVisiblity()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvVariableData)MMSpinBox1_var1).Value);
			int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvVariableData)MMSpinBox2_var1).Value);
			int? num3 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvVariableData)MMSpinBox3_var1).Value);
			object obj = grdParamArray_Int_GridData;
			CxvVectorPropertyData grdVar = (CxvVectorPropertyData)((obj is CxvVectorPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			object obj2 = grdParamArray_Real_GridData;
			CxvVectorPropertyData grdVar2 = (CxvVectorPropertyData)((obj2 is CxvVectorPropertyData) ? obj2 : null);
			object obj3 = grdParamArray_Char_GridData;
			CxvVectorPropertyData grdVar3 = (CxvVectorPropertyData)((obj3 is CxvVectorPropertyData) ? obj3 : null);
			if (num.HasValue && num2.HasValue && num3.HasValue && num.HasValue && num2.HasValue && num3.HasValue)
			{
				switch (Judgement(num, num2, num3))
				{
				case 1:
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"0");
					setGridVisibility(num, num2, grdVar, 2);
					setGridVisibility(num, num3, grdVar, 3);
					break;
				case 2:
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"0");
					setGridVisibility(num, num3, grdVar, 3);
					setGridVisibility(num, num2, grdVar, 2);
					break;
				case 3:
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"0");
					setGridVisibility(num2, num, grdVar2, 1);
					setGridVisibility(num2, num3, grdVar2, 3);
					break;
				case 4:
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"0");
					setGridVisibility(num2, num3, grdVar2, 3);
					setGridVisibility(num2, num, grdVar2, 1);
					break;
				case 5:
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"1");
					setGridVisibility(num3, num, grdVar3, 1);
					setGridVisibility(num3, num2, grdVar3, 2);
					break;
				case 6:
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayIntVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayRealVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("ParamArrayCharVisible", (object)"1");
					setGridVisibility(num3, num2, grdVar3, 2);
					setGridVisibility(num3, num, grdVar3, 1);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private int Judgement(int? Nint, int? Nreal, int? Nchar)
		{
			if (Nint >= Nreal && Nint >= Nchar && Nreal >= Nchar)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (Nint >= Nreal && Nint >= Nchar && Nchar >= Nreal)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (Nreal >= Nint && Nreal >= Nchar && Nint >= Nchar)
			{
				return 3;
			}
			if (Nreal >= Nint && Nreal >= Nchar && Nchar >= Nint)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			if (Nchar >= Nint && Nchar >= Nreal && Nint >= Nreal)
			{
				return 5;
			}
			if (Nchar >= Nint && Nchar >= Nreal && Nreal >= Nint)
			{
				return 6;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void cmdBrowse_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			openFileDialog.Filter = ApwnResources.FileType_Excel_97_2003_Workbook + " (*.xls)|*.xls|" + ApwnResources.FileType_Excel_Macro_Enabled_Workbook + " (*.xlsm)|*.xlsm|" + ApwnResources.FileType_Excel_Binary_Workbook + " (*.xlsb)|*.xlsb";
			openFileDialog.Title = Resources.MMUser2_Setup_Subrou_ViewModel_OpenFile_Title;
			openFileDialog.ReadOnlyChecked = true;
			bool? flag = openFileDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (!flag.HasValue || !flag.Value)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = openFileDialog.FileName;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (text.Length >= 219)
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, 219);
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.EXCEL_FILE", "value", (object)text);
			}
		}
	}
